hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: Alice removes minimum, Bob removes next minimum, Bob appends first then Alice appends.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: In every pair of consecutive elements (nums[2*i], nums[2*i+1]), Bob appends nums[2*i+1] and Alice appends nums[2*i]. Swap adjacent pairs.
